cases.label: poor
cases.original_note: HP ample, other visible resources/card opening unimpressive; possible with higher-value or exhaust support.
cases.zh: 血量充足；当时可见的其他资源和起手一般；若牌组有更高价值牌或消耗体系，仍可能有帮助。

cases.label: adequate
cases.original_note: HP healthy, low-value relics, potions potentially useful; Carnage unupgraded.
cases.zh: 血量健康；遗物价值偏低；药水可能有用；Carnage 未升级。

cases.label: adequate
cases.original_note: Healing potions may be especially useful after turn-2 percentage-HP damage; Red Skull/Orichalcum/Anger provide useful options; full deck still unknown.
cases.zh: 第 2 回合按百分比造成伤害后，治疗药水可能尤其有用；Red Skull、Orichalcum、Anger 提供了可用选项；当时完整牌组仍未知。

cases.label: poor
cases.original_note: Low resources, weak starting hand, no apparent rescue in available view.
cases.zh: 资源较少，起手偏弱；在当时可见信息中没有明显补救手段。

cases.label: adequate
cases.original_note: Conditional on usable potions, deck quality and early turns; Disarm potentially important.
cases.zh: 判断取决于药水是否可用、牌组质量和前几回合表现；Disarm 可能很重要。

cases.label: poor
cases.original_note: Extreme entry HP deficit, with only a low-probability Fire Breathing/Snecko Oil recovery scenario under suitable deck.
cases.zh: 入场时血量极低；只有在牌组合适时，Fire Breathing / Snecko Oil 的恢复情形才可能出现，且概率被认为较低。

note: Issue-recorded first-pass impressions from an incomplete earlier view; not updated or treated as ground truth.
